catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-riev: The Encyclopedia's Rievaulx entry: the Yorkshire dale abbey of St. Aelred. Sheep, books, and prayer filled its valley. Edmond Obrecht honors its golden age. England's Cistercians at their best. Aelred's mirror of charity was written in its chapter house. Its wool made the house rich.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ernst-von-las: A 1913 entry on Ernst von Lasaulx — the Munich philosopher. Karl Hoeber notes his famous works. The entry preserves his modest fame. His pen served the Catholic schools. A thinker of the nineteenth century. His 1856 works are famed.
